title: About This Portfolio
text: This site is a personal playground for learning the pharmaverse - an open-source R ecosystem for clinical trial data analysis - coming from a SAS/SQL background. Expect rough edges: it’s a sandbox for experiments, not polished production work.

title: About This Portfolio
text:
Workflow
Raw Data (XPT)
    │
    ▼
SDTM (standardized clinical data)
    │
    ▼
ADaM (analysis-ready datasets)  ←── admiral
    │
    ▼
TLFs (Tables, Listings, Figures) ←── rtables + tern + ggplot2
    │
    ▼
Quarto Reports (this site)

title: About This Portfolio
text:
Environment
All analyses are run inside the statprog_environment/ directory, which follows a standard statistical programming folder hierarchy:



Folder
Contents




data/raw/
Original source data


data/sdtm/
SDTM datasets


data/adam/
ADaM datasets (CDISC Pilot)


pgms/
Analysis programs (R scripts / QMD)


outputs/
Generated TLF outputs


logs/
Execution logs


metadata/
Specifications and data dictionaries

title: About This Portfolio
text:
Dataset
The CDISC Pilot Project dataset is used throughout. It is a publicly available reference dataset distributed by CDISC that mirrors a real Phase III Alzheimer’s disease clinical trial.

title: Pharmaverse playground
text:
Statistical programmer working in the pharma industry since 2015. Using SAS and SQL as primary tools for data processing and reporting.




Expand my knowledge of R, quarto, tidyverse, and pharmaverse packages
A personal playground for experimenting with the pharmaverse ecosystem and learning clinical reporting in R.
Store interesting snippets/programs along with example TLF outputs
